what: SVG decorations stuck to the section edge (several color bands and pattern pieces) are tied to scroll and grow out piece by piece, width 0 → 1 — the stretch while the element’s top edge travels from 7% below the screen top to 0 is divided by the piece count. Piece i starts at i/n, grows over a .18 share with a cubic ease-out curve, and follows with .25s linear. A piece that has grown does not shrink when scrolling back up. Left decorations pivot on the left, right ones on the right

options.origin: left (default) · right — direction the piece grows
options.start: Start point — at what share of the screen height the element’s top edge counts as 0, default .07
options.end: End position — at what fraction of element height the top edge has passed above the screen to reach 1, default 0
options.follow: Transition seconds for pieces following progress, default .25
options.[data-fx-part=piece]: When you want to pick which pieces grow (optional) — if omitted, all path·rect·circle·ellipse·polygon in the SVG (except those inside defs·clipPath·mask·pattern)

note: The original fetches decorative SVGs, wraps each piece inside in a g and applies scaleX (life-design concept svgGrow). The motion part wraps the pieces of the SVG embedded in the page as they are. Decorations attached at the very top of the hero are already fully grown on open (same as the original).
